2609.02745.title: Incremental Pooled LLM Evaluation for Cost-Effective Retrieval Model Selection
2609.02745.paper_summary: Selecting a retrieval model for a production RAG system requires reliable comparative evaluation, but obtaining relevance judgments at scale is expensive and difficult to repeat as new candidate systems arrive. We study pooled LLM evaluation, in which an LLM judges the union of documents retrieved by the current set of candidate systems, and the pool is then expanded incrementally as new systems are introduced by judging only the new documents they contribute. These judgments are reused to evaluate all systems on a common basis. We validate this approach on four retrieval benchmarks with 11 systems spanning dense, sparse, and hybrid configurations, and deploy it to compare 62 retrieval configurations for a financial news QA system. Pooled LLM rankings correlate strongly with gold-standard evaluation across datasets, and 97% of pairwise system orderings are preserved once bootstrap uncertainty in the qrels is taken into account. In production, document overlap yields 65-80% judgment reuse and up to 4.9x lower evaluation cost, allowing teams to benchmark new retrieval candidates without re-judging previously assessed documents. These results suggest pooled LLM evaluation is a practical and cost-effective workflow for incremental retrieval model selection in deployed systems.
2609.02745.paper_summary_zh: 選擇用於生產 RAG 系統的檢索模型需要可靠的比較評估，但隨著新候選系統的出現，獲取大量相關性判斷既昂貴又難以重複。我們研究了池化 LLM 評估，其中 LLM 評估當前候選系統所檢索到的文檔的聯集，然後隨著新系統的引入，僅通過評估它們貢獻的新文檔來逐步擴展池。這些判斷被重複使用，以在共同的基礎上評估所有系統。我們在四個檢索基準上驗證了這種方法，涵蓋了 11 個系統，這些系統包括密集型、稀疏型和混合型配置，並將其部署以比較金融新聞 QA 系統的 62 種檢索配置。池化 LLM 排名與各數據集的金標準評估強烈相關，並且在考慮到 qrels 中的自助不確定性後，97% 的成對系統排序得以保留。在生產中，文檔重疊產生了 65-80% 的判斷重用，評估成本降低了最多 4.9 倍，使團隊能夠在不重新評估先前評估的文檔的情況下基準化新的檢索候選者。這些結果表明，池化 LLM 評估是一種實用且具成本效益的工作流程，適用於已部署系統中的增量檢索模型選擇。
